description: This file defines the AutoFilter class responsible for parsing and applying auto filter configurations in XLSX spreadsheets within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It processes XML data related to auto filter rules, including standard, custom, dynamic, date range, and top ten filters, and applies these rules to worksheet columns.

classes.name: AutoFilter
classes.description: Handles parsing and applying auto filter rules from XML data to worksheet columns in an XLSX spreadsheet.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the AutoFilter object with a parent worksheet/table and the associated XML data.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads and processes the auto filter configuration from the XML, calling sub-methods to handle specific filter types.

methods.name: readAutoFilter
methods.description: Reads auto filter rules, including standard, custom, dynamic, date, and top ten filters, from the XML and applies them to columns.

methods.name: readDateRangeAutoFilter
methods.description: Processes date range filter rules in the XML and applies them to the column.

methods.name: readCustomAutoFilter
methods.description: Processes custom filters with operators and values, and applies them to the column.

methods.name: readDynamicAutoFilter
methods.description: Processes dynamic filter rules (e.g., today, last month) and applies them.

methods.name: readTopTenAutoFilter
methods.description: Processes top ten/bottom filters, possibly with percentage options, and applies them.
